odc_type: logic error in default value handling
observation_summary: Default values were ignored when a partial number of arguments were provided, resulting in fewer values than expected.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurred because the command-line parser failed to merge default values with user-provided arguments when the number of provided arguments was less than the maximum allowed. The original implementation only returned default values if no arguments were provided at all, ignoring cases where partial arguments were supplied. The fix modifies the logic to check if the number of provided values is less than the number of available default values and, if so, appends the remaining default values to the user-provided list.
